page.overview:
What is 25th Founding?

The 25th Founding of Space Marine Chapters, also known as the "Bastion Founding," occurred during the latter half of the 40th Millennium.

There are only three Chapters that are known to have been founded at this time -- the Emperor's Spears, the Fire Angels and the ill-fated Star Scorpions.
